from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class UniversityMetric(BaseModel):
    """Data extracted from a single university's CDS submission."""
    university_name: str = Field(description="The name of the university")
    full_time_faculty: int = Field(description="Count of full-time instructional faculty")
    part_time_faculty: int = Field(description="Count of part-time instructional faculty")
    graduation_rate_2015: float = Field(description="Six-year graduation rate for the 2015 cohort (percentage value)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    university_metrics: list[UniversityMetric]
